name: 01-onboarding-tour
caption: On the first visit a short tour explains the five steps: add a key, load a corpus, pick strategies, run, and compare.

name: 02-home-hero
caption: The home page. The header holds the navigation, the backend status, the help menu, and the key status pill.

name: 03-simulation-naive-rag
caption: The animated explainer for Naive RAG: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 04-simulation-hybrid-rag
caption: The animated explainer for Hybrid RAG: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 05-simulation-hyde
caption: The animated explainer for HyDE: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 06-simulation-reranker
caption: The animated explainer for Reranker: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 07-simulation-full-context
caption: The animated explainer for Full-Context: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 08-simulation-recursive-summary
caption: The animated explainer for Recursive Summary: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 09-simulation-sliding-window
caption: The animated explainer for Sliding-Window: how it moves a question through the corpus, what it is best for, where it struggles, and its cost.

name: 10-home-how-it-works
caption: The home page's summary of the workflow.

name: 11-glossary
caption: The ? button in the header opens a glossary of the terms used across the app.

name: 12-openrouter-key-dialog
caption: The key dialog. Paste an OpenRouter key (stored only in this browser tab) or rely on a server key from the repo's .env. It also explains that requests carry no app attribution.

name: 13-playground-start
caption: The Playground is a three-step flow: corpus, strategies and model, then a question.

name: 14-playground-sample-corpus
caption: Load sample fills in a small synthetic corpus and shows how it is chunked.

name: 15-playground-strategies-and-model
caption: Pick strategies, then a model. Gemini 3 Flash, the paper's model, is the default.

name: 16-model-dropdown
caption: The model dropdown lists the curated OpenRouter models with their lab, live price, and badges for the paper's model and open-weights models, plus a custom slug option.

name: 17-model-custom-slug
caption: Custom model slug accepts any OpenRouter model id. Use this model checks it against OpenRouter's model list first.

name: 18-model-glm-selected
caption: GLM 5.3 Flash selected. With reasoning on Lowest available, the note explains this model always reasons, so the app requests low effort.

name: 19-playground-question
caption: Type a question or pick a suggested one. The tag shows a pre-flight cost estimate.

name: 20-playground-running
caption: Each strategy streams its pipeline live: indexing, retrieval, and generation, with a running cost.

name: 21-playground-results
caption: Answers from each strategy on GLM 5.3 Flash, with the pipeline trace, tokens, latency, and cost of every step.

name: 22-playground-retrieved-chunks
caption: Open a card's retrieved chunks to see exactly what the model was given, with retrieval scores.

name: 23-compare
caption: Compare lays out the last run side by side: answers, insights, cost, latency, tokens, a cost × latency chart, the pipeline diff, and the retrieval inspector.

name: 24-evaluate-setup
caption: Evaluate grades strategies on your own questions with gold answers: corpus, question set, strategies, then model, temperature, and number of runs. Load the results from a previous test sits at the top.

name: 25-evaluate-model-and-runs
caption: Every strategy uses the same model. Runs repeats the whole evaluation with a different seed each time.

name: 26-recommend
caption: Recommend asks for a use case and a few constraints, then ranks strategies with reasons drawn from the research.

name: 27-history
caption: History keeps runs, evaluations, and saved configurations in this browser, with search, export, and import.

name: 40-result-saved-test-details
caption: The finished test is saved as JSON in studio/results/. The card lists the model, temperature, runs and seeds, reasoning effort, token budget, retrieval and chunking settings, total cost, model calls, and wall time.

name: 41-result-glm-vs-paper
caption: GLM 5.3 Flash against the paper's Gemini 3 Flash results: mean F1 gap, rank agreement, how many strategies land inside the paper's 95% confidence intervals, the top strategy, and per-strategy F1 and cost.

name: 42-result-leaderboard
caption: Mean F1 and EM over 3 runs with the run-to-run spread and bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, plus cost per run and median latency.

name: 43-result-f1-confidence-intervals
caption: Each strategy's F1 with its 95% confidence interval. Overlapping bars mean the difference may be noise.

name: 44-result-per-probe-radar
caption: F1 by probe type (needle, multi-hop, distractor, hallucination, sanity).

name: 45-result-head-to-head-wins
caption: How often each strategy is right where another is wrong, across all question-run pairs.

name: 46-result-significance
caption: Holm-corrected paired Wilcoxon p-values. Pairs that aren't significant are shown as statistically tied.

name: 47-result-refusal-honesty
caption: How often each strategy correctly refuses questions whose answer is not in the corpus.

name: 48-result-question-explorer
caption: Every question with its gold answer. Ticks show the majority result and x/3 counts correct runs.

name: 49-result-question-expanded
caption: Click a question to read every strategy's answer from each of the three runs.

name: 50-result-em-confidence-intervals
caption: The F1 / EM switch redraws every chart with exact match instead of token F1.

name: 51-replay-results-full-page
caption: The whole Replay page after the GLM 5.3 Flash test.

extra.label: GLM 5.3 Flash · paper case study · 3 runs

name: 52-history-after-test
caption: The replay appears in History tagged with its model.

name: 53-profiler-glm
caption: The Profiler starts from GLM 5.3 Flash's list price and shows cost × quality, cost per correct answer, latency, and token use. The sliders re-price the run for any other model.

name: 54-previous-tests-after-run
caption: After the test the list holds two saved tests: GLM 5.3 Flash and the paper's Gemini 3 Flash sweep.

name: 55-loaded-glm-test-details
caption: The saved GLM 5.3 Flash test reopened from its JSON file. Nothing is re-run and nothing is spent.

name: 56-loaded-glm-vs-paper
caption: The comparison with the paper, rebuilt from the saved file.

name: 57-loaded-glm-leaderboard
caption: The leaderboard from the saved file, identical to the one shown when the run finished.

name: 58-loaded-paper-sweep-details
caption: The paper's Gemini 3 Flash sweep loads the same way, imported from the research runs and checked against the paper's table.

name: 59-loaded-paper-sweep-leaderboard
caption: The published Gemini 3 Flash leaderboard, for side-by-side reading with GLM 5.3 Flash.
